svg.title: Hand size
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: hand size set to Large. Marked in red: 1, the zip-tie holes: the four small holes beside the pocket. 2, the pocket: the plug recess on the centerline. 3, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket. 4, the finger holes: the two large holes in the lower half. 5, the body edge: the outer outline.
